name: 420AppStore
purpose: Discover, evaluate and launch registered 420 Integrated applications through a curated but non-authoritative catalogue grounded in canonical Registry and chain provenance.

canonicalSources.appProtocols: application/service manifests and public protocol records discovered through 420Registry

invariants: APP-INV-001: 420AppStore owns no canonical protocol state and requires no AppStore-specific Genesis contract.
APP-INV-002: Listing, delisting, featuring, ranking or reviewing an application cannot create, revoke or rewrite canonical 420Registry registration or chain state.
APP-INV-003: Every listed canonical service/application preserves its Registry service identity, version and implementation provenance rather than replacing those fields with catalogue authority.
APP-INV-004: Categories, rankings, featured placement, reviews, ratings, descriptions and screenshots are non-canonical presentation metadata.
APP-INV-005: Sponsored placement is explicitly labeled and cannot alter canonical publisher, ownership, contract, version, rights, payment, trust or protocol fields.
APP-INV-006: A listing is discovery/curation, not protocol endorsement, investment approval, audit certification or proof of safety.

APP-INV-007: 420AppStore displays requested wallet permissions, capability scopes and high-risk actions before handoff where such metadata is available, but cannot itself grant capabilities or sign transactions.
APP-INV-008: Wallet authorization and transaction confirmation remain controlled by 420Wallet/Smart Accounts; AppStore links and launch actions cannot bypass those boundaries.
APP-INV-009: Published audit, source-verification, trust, deprecation and security-warning evidence remains traceable to its source and is not silently rewritten by the catalogue.
APP-INV-010: Private or encrypted Messenger, Commons and Resource payloads, private Identity fields and raw Attention telemetry are excluded from AppStore indexing.
APP-INV-011: Installation or launch history is not public by default and catalogue operators gain no custody, account-execution, governance, validator, bridge or token-transfer authority.
APP-INV-012: AppStore failure, delisting or censorship cannot block direct Wallet, Registry, Explorer, RPC or contract interaction with an otherwise reachable application.
APP-INV-013: Alternative AppStore clients and catalogues may coexist while deriving canonical identity and version truth from 420Registry and chain state.
